title: Drywall Repair & Interior Paint Preparation
summary: Thorough wall preparation, drywall patching, and surface sanding ready for clean interior paint.
description: Repaired wall imperfections, filled screw and nail holes with smooth spackling, and completed orbital sanding across accent walls and trim borders to ensure a flawless finish prior to priming and painting.

title: Hardwood Staircase & Custom Railing Rebuild
summary: Full transformation removing worn carpeting, reinforcing the underlying framing, and installing custom stained hardwood treads with modern railings.
description: Transformed an outdated, carpeted stairway into a durable architectural centerpiece. This project required stripping down to rough stringers, checking plumb and level, reinforcing structural framing, and custom-cutting solid hardwood treads with crisp white risers. Finished with secure handrails, precision miters, and a multi-coat protective clear finish.

title: Bathroom & Double Vanity Remodel
summary: Comprehensive bathroom remodel featuring a modern vanity install, updated plumbing fixtures, new mirror, and crisp trim work.
description: Modernized this bathroom with a clean, contemporary design. The scope included tearing out the old unit, modifying and re-routing supply and drain lines, securely installing a new vanity cabinet and solid countertop, setting modern plumbing fixtures, installing wall-mounted mirrors, and applying clean, watertight silicone seals along all seams.

title: Downstairs Bathroom Refresh & Fixtures
summary: Clean update to a downstairs bath with new vanity, faucet upgrades, lighting, and modern hardware to maximize functional space.
description: Refreshed this guest bathroom to maximize space and provide a bright, updated aesthetic. The project included safe disconnect and removal of old fixtures, wall repairs, new vanity installation, updated plumbing shutoffs, faucet mounting, and modern towel bar and accessory placements.

title: Custom Built Indoor Play Area
summary: Built-in activity space and play structure designed for safety, imaginative play, and long-term durability.
description: Designed and constructed a custom indoor play nook engineered specifically for the room's proportions. Built using solid structural lumber with rounded, kid-safe edges, countersunk heavy-duty fasteners, and non-toxic durable finishes that easily hold up to active daily use.

title: Raised Garden Beds & Protective Enclosure
summary: Heavy-duty cedar raised garden bed system with integrated pest barrier fencing and hinged access gate.
description: Constructed deep raised garden beds designed for optimal root depth, drainage, and seasonal longevity. Utilized naturally rot-resistant lumber with reinforced corner brackets, paired with an integrated mesh fence enclosure and custom gate to protect crops from local critters while keeping harvesting convenient.
